claims.claim: Volker Türk said more than 5,700 people were killed or injured by gangs or during operations against them in Haiti between January 1 and September 11, 2026.

claims.source_title: More than 5,000 people killed or injured in Haiti due to gang violence this year, UN says

claims.claim: Argentina approved RIGI entry for a Pluspetrol and GyP project at Bajo del Choique-La Invernada worth 12,400 million US dollars over 25 years.

claims.claim: The Vaca Muerta project is planned to exceed 100,000 barrels of oil a day and 12 million cubic meters of gas a day, with more than 620 horizontal wells.

claims.supporting_quote: Llevará la producción a más de 100.000 barriles de petróleo por día y 12 millones de metros cúbicos diarios de gas.

claims.supporting_quote: Aos policiais, Guilherme confessou ter participado do crime e afirmou que já havia participado de cerca de cinco ações semelhantes. Por cada uma delas, disse, recebeu R$ 500.
